lines.t: The wind still whispers through the reeds,
Love remembers what the heart still needs.
Beneath the weight of all that’s gone,
The Spirit hums creation’s song.
Oh Beloved, hush your mind,
The world is cruel, yet God is kind.
He knows your scars, He’s walked before,
He breaks the chains, unlocks the door.
Hear Him now, through the quiet rain,
Every tear has not been in vain.
Be still, Beloved, lay down your fear,
The Lord of hosts is ever near.
The voice that calmed the raging sea,
Holds your heart eternally.
The stars bear witness, strong and true,
Of mercy shining down on you.
Through shattered dreams, through endless night,
His hand shall pull you into light.
When all is lost and hope feels thin,
That is the place His peace begins.
Be still, Beloved, lay down your fear,
The Lord of hosts is ever near.
His whisper soft as morning dew,
Breathes eternal life in you.
And when you hear the trumpet cry,
And all creation lifts its sigh,
Know this fire was meant to cleanse,
Not break, but heal, and make amends.
He walks beside you, unseen friend,
His love unbroken, without end.
Where sorrow lingered, joy will bloom,
The grave is empty, not the tomb.[Final Chorus – soaring, emotional release]
